local gui = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
local world = gui:FindFirstChild('World', true)
local labels = {}
for _, d in gui:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA('ImageLabel') then table.insert(labels, d) end end
local last = {}
local frames, notLoaded, toggles, imgSwaps, maxNot, worstDt = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
local lastImg = {}
local swapNames = {}
local flips = {}
local t = 0
while t < 5 do
	local dt = RS.RenderStepped:Wait()
	t += dt
	frames += 1
	worstDt = math.max(worstDt, dt)
	local n = 0
	for _, l in labels do
		local v = l.Visible
		if v and l.Image ~= '' and not l.IsLoaded then n += 1 end
		if last[l] ~= nil and last[l] ~= v then
			toggles += 1
			flips[l] = (flips[l] or 0) + 1
		end
		last[l] = v
		local im = l.Image
		if lastImg[l] ~= nil and lastImg[l] ~= im then
			imgSwaps += 1
			swapNames[l.Name] = (swapNames[l.Name] or 0) + 1
		end
		lastImg[l] = im
	end
	notLoaded += n
	maxNot = math.max(maxNot, n)
end
